Remark
Source: topping:page-0116 1. ch9:6.2\group curvature-pinching If $X$ is the zero sublevel set of a convex parallel function $\Psi $, it suffices to verify, for every ODE trajectory starting on $\partial X$, \[ \left.\frac{d}{dt}\Psi (e(t))\right|_{t=0}\le 0. \]
